changes.ingredients: Champion ingredient names retain exact rank and component exploration links, with no abbreviations. Basic codes remain displayed.
changes.orderedCatalog: Previous recipe and Next recipe traverse the current filtered ordered champion catalog. Kingslayer advances to King. Search, damage, ability, against-defense and Available/In progress status determine the ordered list; endpoints do not wrap.
changes.history: Back in exploration and Forward in exploration are separate controls. Component inspection preserves filters and history; an inspected component outside the current filters has disabled ordered controls and an explicit Outside current filters label.
changes.frontier: Exact uncovered basic leaves use spaced code/rank text and ASCII multiplicity, e.g. S II, D II, 2x E IV. Built components cover their subtree once; actual owned and eligible provisional resources are subtracted.
changes.engineer: displayDefenderCode uses E for player-facing Engineer labels. Runtime family runebreaker, canonical unitCode R and core defenderCode output remain unchanged.

validation.command: node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/recipe-navigation-v30.test.mjs tests/catalog-recipes-d006.test.mjs tests/crafting-dock.test.mjs tests/grimoire-display.test.mjs tests/recipe-tree.test.mjs tests/recipe-filters.test.mjs tests/recipe-breakdown.test.mjs tests/ranks-recipes.test.mjs
validation.productionHandlers: Tests execute connectChampionCatalog event handlers against real Game objects and DOM fixtures; they cover ordered navigation with fresh history, combined filters, Available and In progress, endpoints, empty/single filters, component Back/Forward, disclosures and focus.

preservation.allocation: Existing recipeTreeProgress continues to allocate physical identities. Tests cover all 38 recipes, nested/repeated basic leaves, built champions, retained resources, reserves, hidden/stale/wall stock, secret eligibility and actual crafting transitions.
preservation.stateAndRng: Repeated display, filtered ordering and component/history navigation preserve actual Game snapshots, inventory, draw commitment, currency, selection and matched RNG streams.
preservation.scope: Only the five listed files were edited for these comments. No main.js, core/data, metadata, audio, art, save or publication changes were made by this subagent.

integration.orderedCatalog: Internal data-catalog-order actions require no main hook; existing connectChampionCatalog/onDetail API remains unchanged.
integration.history: Dock history action IDs remain recipe-history-back and recipe-history-forward; their visible labels now describe exploration history.
integration.displayCode: Export displayDefenderCode(stats,tier,{family}) from ui/recipe-navigation.js for other player-facing basic code surfaces. Champion stats return null; Engineer returns E plus Roman rank.
integration.frontier: craftingDockModel(...).pinned.missingBasics keeps its existing {items,total,summary} contract; the summary formatting is updated.
integration.remainingParentSurfaces: Basic guide/tree totals in ui/grimoire.js and other main/card labels call core defenderCode directly. Parent was informed to adopt the UI-only display helper where global Engineer E display is required.

visualQa: Native browser QA and production build belong to the parent agent.
